notes.title: Update 2.1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I am happy to present to you the new Vanity update, here is a summary of what's new:


Performance & Technical
General performance improvements

Upgraded from DirectX 11 to DirectX 12 for better performance and future support

Network stability improvements
Localization
Italian language support added
Bug Fixes & Minor Changes
Fixed various bugs

Minor changes and overall improvements

notes.title: Update 2.0
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I am happy to present to you the new Vanity update, here is a summary of what's new:


[code]- Removed camera shake when shooting
- Added host migration
- Added cancel reload
- added 2 new weapons in wave mode
- Added a soccer ball to some maps
- Added a new map for control point mode
- Added a new map for Team Deathmatch mode
- Added a server code system to be able to join these friends quickly by entering the code
- We now jump higher on classic game modes
- From now on there are two distinct teams: humans and animals
- We can now customize these parts (only sniper, low gravity, disable capacity and ultimate..)
- We can now aim lower
- Improved editor mode and fixed many issues
- Several new game modes are available in the map editor
- Main menu reworked
- Some other minor changes
- Bug Fixes[/code]

notes.title: Update 1.9
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I am happy to present to you the new Vanity update, here is a summary of what's new:


Reduces the display time of daily challenges

The camera lag effect has been removed

We can now earn Fragments in daily challenges

Improved map for team deathmatch mode

A new ultimate power is now available

We can now open crates to get skins

Added a new weapon, the double barrel

Some other minor changes

Bug Fixes

notes.title: Update 1.8
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I am happy to present to you the new Vanity update, here is a summary of what's new:

- Improved the ultimate wallhack
- We can change crosshairs
- Improvement of the last standing mode
- We can now climb onto the ledges within our reach
- Most of the menus have been reworked to be prettier and simpler
- There may now be changing weather in some modes
- The ultimate bombardment was replaced by a meteor shower
- There are now effects on the camera when we use certain powers
- Many particles have been reworked such as grenade explosions or certain powers
- When we aim at a player, we now see their health bar
- We can now propel ourselves using surfaces such as walls, trees, etc
- We can now dash to, for example, dodge an enemy attack or others
- We now have in-game music
- Some minor changes
- Bug fixes

I hope you like this update, have fun!

notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I am happy to present the new Vanity update, here is a summary of what's new:


Additions :

- Added a grenade that allows you to recover your armor
- Added weapon firing speed information to the equipment selection
- Added pistol
- Added animation when using our abilities
- Added a background system for the profile in the main menu and in the scoreboard
- Added 2 new abilities “telekinesis” and “healing”
- Added music choice to the main menu
- Added Easy Anti Cheat
- Added daily challenges
- Added weapon inspection
- Added a skull in place of a dead player
- Added a global table to see the best players in "Classics" game modes
- Added 4 new character skins for players who own the Military and Suit DLCs
- Added a countdown before a game begins
- Added several types of impact depending on the surface
- Added a new game mode "Bomb"
- Added a new crosshair
- Added a roll when the player falls from a height

improvements : 

- Some maps have received improvements
- Addition of new weapons in arms race
- Some animations have been reworked
- Some models have been modified
- The player slows down when he screws or shoots
- Weapon recoil has been reworked
- Several interfaces have been reworked
- Some abilities have been modified
- Added new challenges
- Improved scoring system
- Improved grenades
- The main menu has been reworked
- Optimization

- Some minor changes
- Bugs Fixe

I hope you like this update, have fun and don't hesitate to join the game's discord to follow the progress and give your feedback.

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, here's a little recap of what's in the update :

- You can now adjust the volume of your microphone
- You can now change weapons more quickly
- The hitmarker turns blue if our target has a shield
- AI can now throw flash grenades and use ultimates
- We now spawn with a shield by default
- We now hear the bullets flying near us
- A shooting animation has been added
- An animation when we are hit has been added
- German and Spanish were added to the translated languages
- A new map has been added for arms race mode
- A new map has been added for Control Point mode
- A lobby system has been added (still in development)
- Bullets do more or less damage depending on the distance
- Bullets do more or less damage depending on the area they hit on the body
- Bullets can now pass through characters
- Bullet tracers have been improved
- There is a notification on discord when a server is created
- The score display when we kill someone or perform an assist has been changed
- Some minor changes
- Bugs Fixes
